title: Filter alerts by status and priority
summary: See only pending, critical, completed or ignored alerts.

inputs.status: All | Pending | Completed | Action Taken | Ignored | Suppressed

steps.title: Menu → Alerts Center
steps.details: What the system detected with the alert rules and the team needs to work on.

steps.title: Status
steps.details: Pending: not worked on. Action taken: something was already done (call, message). Completed: resolved. Ignored: dismissed. Suppressed: the rule no longer applies.

steps.title: Priority
steps.details: Low, medium, high or critical, according to the rule that created the alert.
